svg.title: Cydnee Owens — @cpanda33
svg.desc: Illustrated header: Cydnee Owens, a Black woman engineer with voluminous natural curls and glasses, works at a desk in front of a big loft window looking out on a city skyline and bridge, with plants, books, a laptop, a coffee cup reading Automate Create Iterate Repeat, a terminal window and a transit-map style infrastructure diagram.
svg.text: engineering workflows for a more creative,
CREATIVE ENGINEER · INFRASTRUCTURE THINKER · AI BUILDER · LIFELONG LEARNER
